subject.title: fix(agy): suppress tool use and file links in print-mode summaries

question: Should Antigravity text-only summaries trade a small amount of maximum prompt capacity for cleaner output that suppresses tool narration and local file links?
rationale: Antigravity v1.1.2 exposes no native no-tools print flag, so the narrow prompt-level fix necessarily consumes argv capacity and only the repository owner can accept that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept the capacity tradeoff
options.body: Merge the focused patch because clean summary output is more valuable than retaining the final small portion of the documented argv limit.

options.title: Shorten the directive first
options.body: Request a more compact instruction to preserve additional prompt capacity while retaining the same no-tools and no-links intent.

recommendation.title: Accept the capacity tradeoff
recommendation.body: Merge the focused patch because clean summary output is more valuable than retaining the final small portion of the documented argv limit.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and release integrator for the Antigravity feature, this person is best positioned to accept the user-facing compatibility tradeoff.
